name: Wet Job

angles.text: The stash showcases dwarven engineering ingenuity, serving as a reliable emergency stockpile hidden in rugged terrain.
Dwarven craft is praised during the recovery of the cache, highlighting the enduring quality of their mountain handiwork.
The concept of keeping hidden emergency stashes stowed away in case of a hasty flight is second nature to those who live in the shadows.

aliases: what kind of quest is wet job
faq.answer: Wet Job is a quest involving the retrieval of a hidden emergency stash tucked away in the terrain. The person who prepared the stash made sure to secure supplies in case they needed to flee on short notice.
faq.q: What is the quest Wet Job about?

faq.answer: The stash was planted by someone who prepared an emergency reserve in case they had to flee in a hurry. The recovery reveals a messenger bag nestled with parchment and supplies crafted with notable dwarven engineering.

The clue points toward a picturesque mountainside described as carved from the waterfalls of time, specifically directing searchers toward an eagle's nest high on the rock face where a messenger bag emerges from the soil.
Uncovering the buried messenger bag reveals essential supplies along with a tucked-away parchment, protected by remarkably resilient dwarven craftsmanship.
faq.q: What is found in the messenger bag?

aliases: why is it called wet job
faq.answer: While the title often implies covert or messy field operations, here it connects directly to the mountain landmarks, framed by mist, waterfalls of time, and damp soil concealing the bag.
faq.q: Why is the task called Wet Job?

faq.answer: Upon uncovering and opening the stash, the construction and reliability of the cache are praised as a marvel of dwarven engineering, built to survive outdoor burial.

sections.body: Someone who operates in hazardous conditions knows never to travel without a backup plan. Wet Job involves locating a reserve stash left hidden away in rugged heights. Kept as an emergency measure in case a quick escape becomes necessary, this supply cache sits ready for retrieval should plans go awry.
sections.title: An Emergency Cache

sections.body: The directions point directly toward a scenic mountain vantage described poetically as carved from the waterfalls of time. High upon this rock face sits what is referred to as the eagle's nest. There, partially buried within the earth, rests a weathered messenger bag protecting provisions and parchment against the elements through reliable dwarven craft.
sections.title: The Eagle's Nest

summary: Wet Job is a quest centered on uncovering an emergency reserve stash left high on a mountainside. Prepared for a hasty escape and concealed near a scenic cliffside perch, the recovered supply cache is protected by ingenious dwarven craftsmanship.
